\begin{chapstatus}{Roadmap of this chapter}
By the end of the chapter you can:
\begin{enumerate}[nosep,leftmargin=2em]
\item implement the game as a state machine with three states
\item keep the body in a ring buffer and the grid in an array of bytes
\item detect a collision by reading the grid
\end{enumerate}
It builds on: arrays in memory (Chapter~\ref{ch:information}); finite-state machines (Chapter~\ref{ch:sequential}); .text, .rodata, .data (Chapter~\ref{ch:verm1p1}); latches and flip-flops (Chapter~\ref{ch:sequential}); fixed point (Chapter~\ref{ch:reals}). Next: Chapter~\ref{ch:processor}.
\end{chapstatus}
